Scaffold helpers for bulk middleware/route registration.Builds a ScaffoldRoute for a synchronous handler with the given method and pattern.Builds a ScaffoldRoute for an asynchronous handler with the given method and pattern.Applies each non-nil async middleware to the app, returning early if the app is nil.Applies each non-nil async middleware to the group, returning early if the group or its app is nil.Registers each scaffold route with a non-empty pattern on the app for its method, skipping nil handlers.Registers each scaffold route with a non-empty pattern on the group for its method, skipping nil handlers.

Imports

types, app

Types

ScaffoldRoute = object
  methodKind*: nim_usockets.HttpMethod
  pattern*: string
  case kind*: ScaffoldRouteKind
  of srkSync:
    syncHandler*: SyncHandler
  of srkAsync:
    asyncHandler*: AsyncHandler
ScaffoldRouteKind = enum
  srkSync, srkAsync
